method: Opened original author-hosted paper/notes or original full text via web reader. Bibliographic and cited sections inspected; no source PDF or figure redistributed.

primary.authors: Joseph Teran, Eftychios Sifakis, Geoffrey Irving, Ronald Fedkiw
primary.title: Robust Quasistatic Finite Elements and Flesh Simulation
primary.venue: Eurographics/ACM SIGGRAPH Symposium on Computer Animation
primary.verified: Original title/authors and sections 3–6: quasistatic assumptions, energy forces, constant-strain tetrahedra, F=Ds Dm^-1, summed element stiffness. This contribution derives its own small-strain B^T D B specialization; it does not implement the paper's nonlinear/inversion/contact solver.

primary.title: An Introduction to the Conjugate Gradient Method Without the Agonizing Pain
primary.venue: Carnegie Mellon University technical notes, edition 1 1/4
primary.verified: Sections 3, 11, 12 and appendix B3: quadratic minimum, stopping/recomputed residual, diagonal preconditioning and PCG algorithm. Tests and tolerance choices here are original.

primary.title: Physically Based Modeling: Principles and Practice — Implicit Methods for Differential Equations
primary.verified: Sections 1.1–1.2: stiffness and backward Euler. The vector elastic step and work identity here are independently derived for the authored linear model.

primary.authors: Miles Macklin, Matthias Müller, Nuttapong Chentanez
primary.title: XPBD: Position-Based Simulation of Compliant Constrained Dynamics
primary.verified: Algorithm 1, section 4, equations 5–9 and 16–18: compliance/energy, timestep scaling, multiplier accumulation and Gauss-Seidel update. Constant gradients in our linear fixture permit an exact matched fixed point; finite sweeps remain approximate.

primary.authors: David S. Ryan, Sebastián Domínguez, Stephanie A. Ross, Nilima Nigam, James M. Wakeling
primary.title: The Energy of Muscle Contraction. II. Transverse Compression and Work
primary.verified: Materials and Methods: 3D nearly incompressible active/passive fibre-reinforced model, 30×10×10 mm blocks, energy redistribution and loading direction. Already audited in repository; independently reopened. Not calibration for our linear isotropic block.

primary.authors: Nathan M. Mitchell, Court B. Cutting, Timothy W. King, Aaron Oliker, Eftychios D. Sifakis
primary.title: A Real-Time Local Flaps Surgical Simulator Based on Advances in Computational Algorithms for Finite Element Models
primary.verified: Original title/abstract and Discussion: preliminary surgical training simulator; rate-dependent tissue properties, measurement and patient-specific prediction distinguished from interactive demonstration. No clinical predictive claim imported.

primary.authors: Jarkko T. Iivarinen, Rami K. Korhonen, Petro Julkunen, Jukka S. Jurvelin
primary.title: Experimental and computational analysis of soft tissue stiffness in forearm using a manual indentation device
primary.verified: Original abstract only: layered inverse FE identification in nine subjects. Already audited in repository; independently reopened. No unread publisher methods or fitted modulus reused.

accessLimits: Sifakis/Barbič SIGGRAPH course notes at femdefo.org timed out. Author publication record alone was read; no formulas attributed to the inaccessible course.
